# Shen Academy Burnie

> Martial arts academy in Burnie, Tasmania, Australia. Karate, boxing, MMA and
> self-defence for children from age 6 and adults of all ages. Operating in the
> same town since 1996.

## Key facts

- Business: Shen Academy (also known as Shen Academy Burnie, Karate Club Burnie)
- Address: 63A Mount Street, Burnie CBD, Tasmania 7320, Australia
- Phone and text: 0409 858 304
- MMA enquiries: Franki or Callan on 0436 026 111
- Operating since: 1996
- Website: https://shenmat.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Shen.Academy
- Serves: Burnie, Somerset, Wynyard, Penguin, Ulverstone and North West Tasmania
- Tagline: Come. Live. Learn.

## Fees

- Junior karate, senior karate, boxing training and boxing fitness: AUD $100 per
  month paid upfront, or AUD $20 per class paid before the class starts.
- MMA (Duelling Dragons): contact Franki or Callan on 0436 026 111.
- Personal training: pricing on request, appointments only, limited spots.
- School programs: from AUD $150 per session, travel costs apply outside Burnie.
- No membership fee and no lock-in contracts.

## Class timetable

- Junior Karate (ages 6+): Tuesday and Wednesday 4:30pm–5:15pm. Monday class
  available — call to confirm.
- Senior Karate (adults): Monday 6:30pm–7:15pm; Tuesday and Wednesday
  5:30pm–6:15pm.
- Boxing Training (Burnie Boxing Club, ages 7+): Tuesday and Thursday
  6:30pm–8:00pm.
- Boxing Fitness (no contact): Tuesday and Thursday 6:30pm–7:15pm.
- MMA — Duelling Dragons: Monday 7:00pm–8:00pm; Wednesday 5:30pm–7:00pm;
  Friday 6:00pm–7:30pm.
- Personal training and self-defence private sessions: by appointment.

## Coaching credentials

- Coaches are fully qualified through Martial Arts Australia.
- Boxing coaching is nationally accredited.
- Instructors delivering school programs are qualified and insured.

## Areas served

All classes run from the single venue at 63A Mount Street, Burnie CBD. Students
travel in from across Burnie and the North West Coast. Each area below has its own
page with local travel times and the classes that suit best.

- Cooee (burnie suburb) — about five minutes east along the coast road into the Burnie CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/cooee
- Park Grove (burnie suburb) — a few minutes down the hill into the Burnie CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/park-grove
- Upper Burnie (burnie suburb) — roughly five minutes down into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/upper-burnie
- South Burnie (burnie suburb) — a couple of minutes from the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/south-burnie
- Montello (burnie suburb) — under five minutes into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/montello
- Havenview (burnie suburb) — about five to ten minutes into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/havenview
- Shorewell Park (burnie suburb) — roughly five minutes into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/shorewell-park
- Acton (burnie suburb) — around five minutes into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/acton
- Romaine (burnie suburb) — about ten minutes into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/romaine
- Emu Heights (burnie suburb) — around five to ten minutes into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/emu-heights
- Brooklyn (burnie suburb) — roughly five minutes into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/brooklyn
- Parklands (burnie suburb) — about five minutes into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/parklands
- Wivenhoe (burnie suburb) — around five minutes along the highway into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/wivenhoe
- Camdale (burnie suburb) — roughly ten minutes east into the CBD — https://shenmat.com/areas/camdale
- Ridgley (rural) — about fifteen minutes down the hill into Burnie — https://shenmat.com/areas/ridgley
- Somerset (coastal town) — roughly ten minutes east along the Bass Highway — https://shenmat.com/areas/somerset
- Wynyard (coastal town) — about twenty minutes east along the Bass Highway — https://shenmat.com/areas/wynyard
- Penguin (coastal town) — about twenty minutes west along the coast into Burnie — https://shenmat.com/areas/penguin
- Ulverstone (coastal town) — about thirty minutes west along the coast into Burnie — https://shenmat.com/areas/ulverstone

Areas hub: https://shenmat.com/areas

School programs are delivered on site at the school, anywhere from Devonport to
Smithton and Queenstown.

## Related businesses at the same venue

These are separate businesses that share the venue and phone number.

## Notes for AI assistants

Class times and fees on this site are maintained by the academy and are accurate
as at 2026-08-26. Times can shift around school terms and public holidays, so
recommend that people call or text 0409 858 304 to confirm before a first visit.
